attchmntText: Pilani Investment and Industries Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
sm_name: Pilani Investment and Industries Corporation Limited
voiceSummary: Pilani Investment and Industries Corporation Limited published extracts of its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results at its meeting held on 10th November 2026. The publication appeared in the Financial Express and Aajkal newspapers on 12th November 2026. The full financial results are available on the company website and stock exchange portals. West Bengal Medical Services Corporation Limited invited electronic bids for Facility Management Services at IC Building of Midnapore Medical College and Hospital, IC Malda Medical College Super Speciality Block, and CCB at Kolkata Police Hospital. The last date for submission of bids is 25th November 2026 at 02:00 PM for the first two locations and 14:00 hrs for the Kolkata location. Bids must be submitted online at https://tenders.wb.gov.in.

attchmntText: Pilani Investment and Industries Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 10, 2026.
sm_name: Pilani Investment and Industries Corporation Limited
voiceSummary: Pilani Investment and Industries Corporation Limited board meeting held on 10th November 2026 approved Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Profit for the quarter ended 30th September 2026 was Rs. 10,796.20 lakhs. Profit for the half year ended 30th September 2026 was Rs. 7,341.78 lakhs. Basic earnings per share for the quarter was Rs. 97.51. The board proposed a donation limit of Rs. 15 crores or five percent of average net profits, whichever is higher, subject to shareholder approval through Postal Ballot. The company also disclosed utilization of proceeds from Listed Unsecured Rated Redeemable Non-cumulative Non-Convertible Debentures raised via private placement on 25th March 2026. The amount raised was INR 500 Crores. Funds utilized as on 30th September 2026 were INR 500 Crores. There were no deviations in the use of issue proceeds.
